caption: Castello di Soave, Soave
composition: Medieval hilltop castle above vineyards and the walled town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From an elevated viewpoint, the camera takes in the Castello di Soave crowning its wooded hill in the sunny 10:23 morning. The crenellated walls and square keep rise at center above the dark green woods, terraced vineyards stripe the slopes left and right, and the walled town of Soave clusters at the lower right with its own battlemented wall. Hazy blue hills roll to the horizon under a bright sky, the whole landscape glowing in late-morning light.
